payload.markdown: These fields should be mostly self-explanatory. The exception might be that leading namespace—poppbook, in this case—which is separated from the actual package name by a forward slash. This is known as the vendor name. As you might expect, the vendor name becomes a top-level directory under vendor/ when your package is installed. This is often the organization name used by the package owner in GitHub or Bitbucket.

payload.markdown: With all that in place, you are ready to commit your package to your version control host of choice. If you’re not sure what that involves, you can learn a lot more about this subject in Chapter 17.
